job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
The Opportunity

We are seeking a commercially astute Business Development Manager to join a leading Building Services division.

This is a high-impact, new business-focused role responsible for identifying, developing, and securing opportunities across key sectors. You will own the full sales lifecycle—from origination through to negotiation and contract close—working closely with operations and bid teams to ensure seamless delivery.

This role suits a professional who combines strategic thinking with execution, and who is motivated by driving measurable revenue growth and building long-term client partnerships.

What’s on Offer

  • $150K base salary (depending on experience)
  • Uncapped commission with clear, transparent targets
  • $20K car allowance
  • Direct access to experienced and supportive leadership
  • Career progression within a national organisation
  • Ongoing professional development and industry exposure
  • High-performance, collaborative team environment
  • Opportunity to directly influence business growth and outcomes

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and secure new business opportunities across target markets
  • Develop and maintain a strong, qualified sales pipeline
  • Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and decision-makers
  • Design and present tailored building services solutions
  • Manage end-to-end sales process from lead generation to contract execution
  • Prepare proposals, pricing submissions, and presentations
  • Negotiate and close commercial agreements
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful onboarding and delivery
  • Maintain accurate CRM reporting and pipeline forecasting
  • Represent the business at industry events and forums
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and growth opportunities

About You

You are a results-driven B2B sales professional with a proven ability to originate and close complex deals.

You bring experience within Building Services, Facilities Management, Construction, or a related sector, and are confident engaging with multiple stakeholders across long sales cycles.

You will demonstrate

  • Consistent success in new business development and revenue growth
  • Strong prospecting and pipeline generation capability
  • Commercial acumen and advanced negotiation skills
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and stakeholder expectations
  • Resilience, persistence, and accountability for outcomes
  • Structured approach to CRM and sales management
  • Trade background (Electrical, Carpentry) or Bachelor of Business

About the Company

Our client is a leading national provider of integrated facility and building services, with over 25 years of industry experience and a workforce of 5000+.

They deliver innovative, high-quality solutions across commercial, industrial, and infrastructure sectors, with a reputation built on service excellence, sustainability, and long-term client partnerships.

Apply Now

This is a rare opportunity to join a respected national organisation in a pivotal growth role.

For a confidential discussion, contact Terri Coombes on 03 9088 2279 or apply now with your resume.
